night3_start.name: {name}
night3_start.text: *Back in my room, I hang my bag over the chair.*

night3_start_2.name: {name}
night3_start_2.text: *I turn on the phone lying face down on my desk.*

night3_faithful_msg_seo_1.name: Seoyeon
night3_faithful_msg_seo_1.text: What you saw today stays between us.

night3_faithful_msg_seo_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_seo_3.text: *I read the message to the end and turn off the screen. The phone's glow disappears from the room.*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_1.name: Yuna
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_1.text: *Yuna sends a photo of a single line from her notebook.*

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2.name: Yuna
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2.text: That novel, I still haven’t decided on the ending

night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_yuna_2_b.text: *The cursor blinks on the last line of the note. A saved icon remains beside the filename.*

night3_faithful_msg_dain_1.name: Dain
night3_faithful_msg_dain_1.text: if you wanna ask about my ankle, ask me in person lol

night3_faithful_msg_dain_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_msg_dain_3.text: *There is a long gap between “lol” and the next sentence. No new message comes from Dain.*

night3_dream_1.name: {name}
night3_dream_1.text: *In my dream, I walk beside someone whose face I can't see. Only our footsteps continue in the same rhythm.*

night3_dream_2_b.name: {name}
night3_dream_2_b.text: *I close the notes app. I still have no sentence to send tomorrow.*

night3_faithful_reflect_1.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_1.text: *Morning sunlight through the curtains wakes me. I open my phone's gallery, scroll to Sojeong's photo, and press and hold.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_b.text: *'Delete this photo?' My finger hovers over the confirm button.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_c.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_c.text: *For one second, I stare at the screen. Sojeong's graffitied desk and the thirty-eight mornings I looked away return one after another.*

night3_faithful_reflect_2_d.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_2_d.text: *Okay. I press the screen with the finger resting over Delete.*

night3_faithful_reflect_3.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_3.text: *My finger stops over the delete button. Instead, I move the photo to a new folder named 'Record.'*

night3_faithful_reflect_3_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_3_b.text: *“Saying no is something you have to do, too.” Minsu's words come back to me. Sojeong is smiling in the gallery, and the Send button on unsent memo thirty-eight is still blue.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4.text: *Sojeong's photo disappears from the gallery, leaving only an empty space.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4_b.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4_b.text: *I rub my thumb over the empty album thumbnail.*

night3_faithful_reflect_4_c.name: {name}
night3_faithful_reflect_4_c.text: *When I close the phone, the empty space in the gallery seems superimposed on the black screen.*

night3_dream_seo_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_seo_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, the rooftop railing comes to mind first.*

night3_dream_yuna_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_yuna_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, the library annex window comes to mind first.*

night3_dream_dain_bonus.name: {name}
night3_dream_dain_bonus.text: *When I close my eyes, I hear a ball bouncing on the gym floor.*

night3_cheat_msg_1.name: {name}
night3_cheat_msg_1.text: *The moment I return to my room, I turn on my phone.*

night3_cheat_msg_2.name: Seoyeon
night3_cheat_msg_2.text: Be that way only with me.

night3_cheat_msg_3_b.name: Seoyeon
night3_cheat_msg_3_b.text: *She types the word 'please.' The cursor sits after it for a long time.*

night3_cheat_msg_4_b.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_4_b.text: *Neither I nor they want to be your backup.*

night3_cheat_msg_5.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_5.text: *Decide who you're going to choose tomorrow.*

night3_cheat_msg_dain_1.name: Dain
night3_cheat_msg_dain_1.text: lol I wish this were a joke

night3_cheat_msg_7.name: Yuna
night3_cheat_msg_7.text: *Three message bubbles rise in a row from Yuna.*

night3_nightmare_1.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_1.text: *I lie down with the lights off, but sleep won't come. Only my phone screen glows against my palm.*

night3_nightmare_2_b.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_2_b.text: *I open Seoyeon's chat. Her last message is “Please.” Nothing new follows it.*

night3_nightmare_3.name: Seoyeon
night3_nightmare_3.text: I'm not asking you to answer now. Just don't avoid me tomorrow.

night3_nightmare_3_b.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_3_b.text: *Only a read receipt sits beneath the three lines Yuna sent.*

night3_nightmare_4.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_4.text: *Her last sentence is short: 'Don't avoid me. That's all.'*

night3_nightmare_4_b.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_4_b.text: *Only one sentence marked with laughter has arrived in Dain's chat.*

night3_nightmare_5.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_5.text: *'I wish it had been a joke.' There are no new messages after that.*

night3_nightmare_6.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_6.text: *I open and close all three chats in turn. In each text box, I type a different first letter, then erase it.*

night3_nightmare_choice.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_choice.text: *Who will I be honest with first tomorrow?*
choices: Decide to talk to Seoyeon first
Decide to talk to Yuna first
Decide to talk to Dain first

night3_nightmare_seo.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_seo.text: *In Seoyeon's text box, I write, “I'll tell you face-to-face tomorrow,” and rest my thumb over Send.*

night3_nightmare_yuna.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_yuna.text: *In Yuna's text box, I write, “Tomorrow, I won't avoid you. I'll tell you,” and the cursor blinks after the final period.*

night3_nightmare_dain.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_dain.text: *In Dain's text box, I write, “I'm sorry I kept you waiting. I'll tell you tomorrow,” and press my thumb against the outline of the send icon.*

night3_nightmare_end.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_end.text: *One sentence remains in one text box. I close the other two chats. Nothing has been sent yet.*

night3_nightmare_end_3.name: {name}
night3_nightmare_end_3.text: *Still awake at three in the morning, I close the messages and open the gallery. I rest my thumb on Sojeong's photo.*

night3_cheat_reflect_2.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_2.text: *In the group photo, Sojeong is looking at the camera. Beside her, I'm looking somewhere else.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_b.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_b.text: *I close the photo and return to my messages. The sentence I wrote earlier is still saved as a draft.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_c.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_c.text: *I scan the list. A different last sentence remains beside each of the three names.*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_d.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_d.text: *Minsu has replied, 'Putting it off won't make it disappear.'*

night3_cheat_reflect_3_e.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_3_e.text: *I read all three chats again from the top. I don't close any of them.*

night3_cheat_reflect_5.name: {name}
night3_cheat_reflect_5.text: *I pull my hand away from Send and turn the phone face down. Three hours until my alarm.*

night3_end.name: {name}
night3_end.text: *I turn off the light and leave my phone face down.*
